channel.title: Joe Hartmann Finds
channel.description: Joe Hartmann Finds is a growing collection of Amazon affiliate finds from Joe Hartmann's Pinterest boards, each with a short article and links to the pin and to Amazon.

item.title: Apple AirPods Pro 2 Wireless Earbuds (USB-C) – Active Noise Cancellation and a Holiday Gift Idea
item.description: A closer look at Apple AirPods Pro 2 with USB-C charging, featuring Active Noise Cancellation, Transparency mode, Adaptive Audio, Personalized Spatial Audio, and the H2 chip.

item.title: Amazon Echo Dot (5th Gen) Smart Speaker with Alexa – Compact Speaker for Bedroom, Kitchen & Office
item.description: A closer look at the Amazon Echo Dot (5th Gen, 2022 release) in Charcoal, a compact Alexa smart speaker for music, timers, questions, and smart home control.

item.title: Hatch Restore 3 Sunrise Alarm Clock & Sound Machine – Wake Up Gently, Sleep Better
item.description: A closer look at the Hatch Restore 3 in Cocoa, a sunrise alarm clock and sleep sound machine with customizable light and audio for bedtime and wake-up routines.

item.title: Tree Hut Tropic Glow Sugar Body Scrub 18 oz – The Viral Shower Routine Scrub
item.description: A closer look at Tree Hut Tropic Glow Shea Sugar Scrub, a sugar body exfoliant with shea butter, a 6-oil blend, and a warm almond, amber, and sandalwood scent.

item.title: e.l.f. Power Grip Primer – The Viral Gripping Gel Primer for Long-Lasting Makeup
item.description: A closer look at e.l.f. Power Grip Primer, a hydrating, gel-based gripping primer that goes on clear and helps makeup stay put.

item.title: CeraVe Hydrating Facial Cleanser 16 oz – Gentle Face Wash with Hyaluronic Acid & Ceramides
item.description: A closer look at CeraVe Hydrating Facial Cleanser, a fragrance-free, non-foaming face wash with ceramides, hyaluronic acid, and glycerin for normal to dry skin.

item.title: Paula's Choice 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant – Cult Favorite for Pores, Blackheads & Smooth Skin
item.description: A closer look at Paula's Choice SKIN PERFECTING 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant, a fragrance-free, leave-on salicylic acid exfoliant for pores, blackheads, and texture.

item.title: medicube Zero Pore Pads 2.0 – Viral Korean Exfoliating Toner Pads with AHA & BHA
item.description: A closer look at medicube Zero Pore Pad 2.0, dual-textured Korean toner pads with 4.5% AHA lactic acid and 0.45% BHA salicylic acid, 70 pads per jar.

item.title: Mighty Patch Original Pimple Patches 36 Ct – Viral Overnight Hydrocolloid Acne Patches
item.description: A closer look at Mighty Patch Original by Hero Cosmetics, ultra-thin hydrocolloid pimple patches made to wear overnight, with 36 patches per box.

item.title: LANEIGE Lip Sleeping Mask – Overnight Lip Treatment for Soft, Hydrated Lips
item.description: A closer look at the LANEIGE Lip Sleeping Mask, a leave-on Korean overnight lip treatment with shea butter, murumuru seed butter, vitamin C, and a berry complex.

item.title: COSRX Snail Mucin 96% Essence – Viral Korean Skincare Serum for Glass Skin Hydration
item.description: A closer look at COSRX Snail Mucin 96% Power Repairing Essence, a lightweight 3.38 fl oz K-beauty essence formulated with 96.3% snail secretion filtrate for hydration.

item.title: Mielle Rosemary Mint Hair Oil with Biotin – The Viral TikTok Scalp & Hair Strengthening Oil
item.description: A closer look at Mielle Organics Rosemary Mint Scalp & Hair Strengthening Oil, a 2 oz blend of rosemary, mint, biotin, and other oils for scalp and ends.

item.title: Kitsch Satin Pillowcase with Zipper – Silky Pillowcase for Hair & Skin, Viral Sleep Find
item.description: A closer look at the Kitsch satin pillowcase with a zipper closure, a smooth polyester satin standard-size pillowcase in ivory designed to reduce friction on hair.

item.title: Revlon One-Step Volumizer Plus Hot Air Brush – Salon-Style Blowout at Home
item.description: A closer look at the REVLON One-Step Volumizer Plus, a hot air brush with a 2.8-inch oval barrel that dries and styles damp hair in one step.

item.title: Ninja AF101 4 Qt Air Fryer – Crispy Fries & Wings with Little to No Oil, 4-in-1
item.description: A closer look at the Ninja AF101 4-quart air fryer, with Air Fry, Roast, Reheat, and Dehydrate programs and a dishwasher-safe nonstick basket and crisper plate.

item.title: Dash Mini Waffle Maker – 4 Inch Nonstick Waffle Iron for Chaffles, Dorms & Small Kitchens
item.description: A closer look at the Dash Mini Waffle Maker in Red, a compact 4-inch nonstick waffle iron with an indicator light that suits dorms, small kitchens, and quick breakfasts.

item.title: Scrub Daddy + Scrub Mommy Sponges 8 Pack – Smiley Face Dish Scrubbers from TikTok
item.description: A closer look at the Scrub Daddy Original and Scrub Mommy 8 pack, with temperature-controlled FlexTexture, a sudsy ResoFoam side, odor resistance, and scratch-free cleaning on 25+ surfaces.

item.title: The Pink Stuff Miracle Cleaning Paste – Viral TikTok Cleaner for Sinks, Stovetops & Grime
item.description: A closer look at Stardrops The Pink Stuff cleaning paste (500g), a multi-purpose, non-scratch paste for grease, grime, burnt-on food, soap scum, and limescale around the home.

item.title: Owala FreeSip 24 oz Insulated Water Bottle – Sip or Swig Straw Lid, Viral TikTok Bottle
item.description: A closer look at the Owala FreeSip 24 oz water bottle in Denim, with a two-way sip-or-swig spout, a push-button lid that locks, and triple-wall insulation for cold drinks.

item.title: Stanley Quencher H2.0 30 oz Tumbler – The Viral TikTok Cup That Fits Your Car Cup Holder
item.description: A closer look at the Stanley Quencher H2.0 FlowState 30 oz tumbler in Lilac, with a comfort-grip handle, a three-position lid with reusable straw, and a narrow base made for most cup holders.

item.title: Rubber Golf Tee Holder for Hitting Mats – 2" Driving Range Tee Adapter
item.description: A closer look at the JP Lann 2-inch rubber golf tee holder, a practice-mat adapter that accepts a wooden tee so you can set driver height on a simulator or range mat.

item.title: Pride PTS Wood Golf Tees 2-3/4" 175 Count – Color-Coded Height Tees for Drivers & Woods
item.description: A closer look at PrideSports Professional Tee System wood tees in a 175-count, 2-3/4-inch pack, hardwood tees with a color bar that identifies length for consistent teeing.

item.title: GoSports Golf Alignment Sticks 2 Pack – 48" Collapsible Swing Training Aids
item.description: A closer look at the GoSports 48-inch collapsible alignment sticks, a two-pack of fiberglass training rods for stance, ball position, and swing path at the range or on a simulator mat.

item.title: CHAMPKEY Double-Sided Golf Chipping Net with Hitting Mat & 12 Foam Balls
item.description: A closer look at the CHAMPKEY double-sided golf chipping net, a pop-up indoor short-game net with target pockets on one side, an open back, a dual-turf mat, and 12 foam balls.

item.title: Golfguru 9.8 ft Putting Green Mat with Ball Return & Alignment Mirror
item.description: A closer look at the Golfguru 9.8-foot putting mat, a crystal-velvet indoor green with two holes, distance markings, an automatic ball return, and an alignment mirror.

item.title: Perfect Practice 9'6" Putting Mat – Indoor Putting Green with Ball Return & Alignment Guides
item.description: A closer look at the Perfect Practice Standard 9-foot-6-inch putting mat, a crystal-velvet indoor green with two cup sizes, alignment guides, and an automatic ball return.

item.title: BenQ MW632ST Short Throw Projector 3200 Lumens – Home Sim Bay Projector
item.description: A closer look at the BenQ MW632ST, a 3,200-lumen WXGA short-throw projector with 1.2x zoom, auto keystone, and dual HDMI, often used in compact golf simulator rooms.

item.title: Optoma GT1080HDR Short Throw Projector – 3,800 Lumens 1080p, Low Input Lag
item.description: A closer look at the Optoma GT1080HDR, a short-throw 1080p projector with 3,800 lumens, HDR-compatible inputs, and a low-lag gaming mode often used in home golf simulator bays.

item.title: All Turf Mats 4x5 Fairway Golf Mat – Residue-Free Nylon Hitting Mat, Made in USA
item.description: A closer look at the All Turf Mats 4x5 Fairway golf mat with 5mm foam backing, a rollable nylon turf mat made in Dalton, Georgia, for iron, wedge, and simulator practice.

item.title: Country Club Elite 1x3 ft Golf Hitting Strip – Real Fairway Feel, Takes Real Tees
item.description: A closer look at the Real Feel Golf Mats Country Club Elite 1x3 hitting strip, a compact nylon turf insert that accepts real tees and can upgrade a simulator hitting area.

item.title: Real Feel Country Club Elite 4x5 Golf Hitting Mat – Takes a Real Tee, Made for Simulators
item.description: A closer look at the Real Feel Golf Mats Country Club Elite 4x5 commercial hitting mat, a thick nylon-blend turf mat that accepts real tees and is designed for downward, through-the-ball contact.

item.title: Spornia SPG-7 Golf Practice Net with Automatic Ball Return, Target Sheet & Side Barriers
item.description: A closer look at the Spornia SPG-7, a 7-foot pop-up golf practice net with automatic ball return, a noise-reducing target sheet, a roof attachment, and a chipping basket.

item.title: GoSports 10x7 ft Golf Practice Hitting Net – Portable Driving Range for Indoor or Outdoor Use
item.description: A closer look at the GoSports 10 x 7 ft golf practice hitting net, a portable indoor-outdoor net with a ball-return feature and a carrying case.

item.title: GoSports ELITE Steel Frame Golf Hitting Net 10x7 ft – Heavy-Duty Simulator Net for Home & Garage
item.description: A closer look at the GoSports Golf Net Elite 10x7 ft, a powder-coated steel-frame hitting net with high-tension netting for indoor or outdoor full-swing practice.

item.title: GoSports Golf Simulator Impact Screen – HD Projector Screen for Real Golf Balls, Fits Elite Net
item.description: A closer look at the GoSports golf simulator impact screen, a high-density woven-polyester projection surface sized to fit the GoSports 10 x 7 ft ELITE golf net.

item.title: GoSports Golf Simulator Enclosure 12x9 ft – Complete Frame, Blackout Panels & HD Impact Screen
item.description: A closer look at the GoSports 12 x 9 ft golf simulator enclosure, a steel-frame bay with a 4:3 HD impact screen, blackout side and top panels, and interior foam padding.

item.title: PRGR Portable Golf Launch Monitor – Doppler Radar Swing Speed, Ball Speed & Carry Distance
item.description: A closer look at the PRGR HS-130A, a pocket-sized Doppler-radar launch monitor that shows club speed, ball speed, smash factor, and estimated carry or total distance on a built-in screen.

item.title: Voice Caddie SC4 PRO Golf Launch Monitor & 3D Driving Range Simulator with Built-In Screen
item.description: A closer look at the Voice Caddie Swing Caddie SC4 PRO, a Doppler-radar golf launch monitor with a built-in screen, voice output, and a 3D driving range in the VoiceCaddie S app.

item.title: Rapsodo MLM2PRO Golf Launch Monitor & Simulator – Dual Camera, 15 Metrics, Indoor & Outdoor
item.description: A closer look at the Rapsodo MLM2PRO, a portable golf launch monitor that combines Doppler radar with dual cameras, 15 metrics, and optional simulated courses.

item.title: Garmin Approach R10 Portable Golf Launch Monitor – Home Golf Simulator & Driving Range Tracker
item.description: A closer look at the Garmin Approach R10, a portable golf launch monitor that tracks club and ball metrics, records swing video, and plays virtual rounds in the Garmin Golf app.

item.title: Logitech MX Keys S Wireless Keyboard – Backlit Low-Profile Desk Keyboard
item.description: A closer look at the Logitech MX Keys S, a low-profile backlit wireless keyboard with smart illumination, multi-device pairing, and a laptop-like typing feel.

item.title: Breville Bambino Plus Espresso Machine – Compact Stainless Home Barista
item.description: A closer look at the Breville Bambino Plus, a compact stainless espresso machine with a 3-second ThermoJet heat-up, automatic microfoam, and a 54 mm portafilter.

item.title: Ember Temperature Control Smart Mug 2 – App-Controlled Heated Coffee Mug
item.description: A closer look at the Ember Mug 2 in 10 oz white, an app-controlled heated mug that holds a set temperature on a charging coaster or on its built-in battery.

item.title: Garmin Venu 3 Smartwatch – 45mm AMOLED Fitness Watch, 14-Day Battery
item.description: A closer look at the Garmin Venu 3, a 45 mm AMOLED GPS smartwatch with Body Battery energy monitoring, sleep coaching, and a built-in speaker and microphone for calls.

item.title: Anker Prime 240W Charging Station – 8-in-1 USB-C Desk Charger
item.description: A closer look at the Anker Prime 240W 8-in-1 charging station, a compact desk hub with four USB-C ports, two USB-A ports, two AC outlets, and up to 140W from a single USB-C port.

item.title: DJI Mini 4K Camera Drone – Under 249g 4K UHD with 3-Axis Gimbal
item.description: A closer look at the DJI Mini 4K, a foldable camera drone under 249 g with 4K UHD video, a 3-axis gimbal, and beginner-friendly flight tools such as Auto Return.

item.title: Logitech MX Master 4 Wireless Mouse – Ergonomic Haptic Productivity Mouse
item.description: A closer look at the Logitech MX Master 4, an ergonomic wireless mouse with haptic feedback, MagSpeed scrolling, an 8K DPI sensor, and multi-device pairing.

item.title: Braun Series 9 PRO+ Electric Shaver – Wet & Dry Foil Razor with SmartCare
item.description: A closer look at the Braun Series 9 PRO+ 9697cc, a Made-in-Germany wet-and-dry foil shaver with Pro SensoAdapt, a 6-in-1 SmartCare center, and a ProComfort head.

item.title: Kindle Paperwhite 16GB (2024) – 7-Inch Glare-Free E-Reader, Weeks of Battery
item.description: A closer look at the 2024 Kindle Paperwhite 16GB, a 7-inch glare-free e-reader with adjustable warm light, USB-C charging, and a waterproof design for travel and everyday reading.

item.title: Sony WH-1000XM6 Noise Cancelling Headphones – Flagship ANC for Work and Travel
item.description: A closer look at Sony’s WH-1000XM6 wireless headphones, with adaptive noise cancellation, a foldable design, and long battery life for work, commutes, and travel.
